Base64 tool guide

With the Base64 encoder you can convert text to Base64 format or decode Base64 strings to readable text in your browser.

1. Encoding (Encode)

Type regular text into the input field and press Koodaa (Encode). An encoded Base64 string will appear in the result field.

2. Decoding (Decode)

Paste the Base64-encoded string into the field and press Pura (Decode). The tool returns the original readable text with UTF-8 support.
